description: Commit 24 — Hospital profile page at /dashboard/hospital/profile with editable name/address and licence document upload. Mirrors the donor profile/photo-upload pattern exactly. Depends on FEAT-001 (hospitalApi.me exists) and FEAT-002 (hospital.ts actions file exists). Independent of FEAT-003.
steps: 1. Edit src/lib/validations.ts: add `hospitalEditSchema = z.object({ hospitalName: z.string().trim().min(2, 'Enter the hospital name.').max(120, 'Keep it under 120 characters.'), hospitalAddress: z.string().trim().min(5, 'Enter the full address.').max(200, 'Keep it under 200 characters.') })`. Export `HospitalEditValues = z.infer<typeof hospitalEditSchema>`.

2. Edit src/lib/hospitals.ts: add to `hospitalApi`: `updateProfile(token, body: HospitalEditValues)` → `api<Hospital>('/hospitals/me', { method: 'PATCH', token, cache: 'no-store', body })`. Add `uploadLicence(token, formData: FormData)` using raw fetch to `${API_URL}/hospitals/me/licence` with `method: 'POST'`, `headers: { authorization: 'Bearer ' + token }`, `body: formData`, `cache: 'no-store'`. Return the parsed envelope or throw. Import `API_URL` from `@/lib/api` and `HospitalEditValues` from `@/lib/validations`.

3. Edit src/app/actions/hospital.ts: add `updateHospitalProfile(values: HospitalEditValues): Promise<ActionResult>` — parse with `hospitalEditSchema`, call `hospitalApi.updateProfile(token, parsed.data)`, `revalidatePath('/dashboard/hospital', 'layout')`, return `{ ok: true }` or `{ error }`. Add `uploadLicenceDoc(formData: FormData): Promise<ActionResult>` — get file from `formData.get('licence')`, validate type (jpeg/png/webp/pdf) and size (max 5 MB = 5*1024*1024 bytes), call `hospitalApi.uploadLicence(token, formData)` via raw fetch (same raw-fetch pattern as `uploadDonorPhoto` in donor.ts), `revalidatePath('/dashboard/hospital', 'layout')`, return `{ ok: true }` or `{ error }`. Allowed MIME types const: `['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp', 'application/pdf']`. Max bytes const: `5 * 1024 * 1024`.
4. Create src/app/dashboard/hospital/profile/loading.tsx: export default Loading() returning `<FormSkeleton fields={2} />`.

5. Create src/app/dashboard/hospital/profile/hospital-profile-form.tsx: `"use client"`. Imports: `useTransition`, `useForm` from react-hook-form, `zodResolver`, `Check` lucide icon, `toast` sonner, `updateHospitalProfile` from `@/app/actions/hospital`, `Button` from `@/components/ui/button`, `FieldError, Input, Label` from `@/components/ui/input`, `Spinner` from `@/components/ui/spinner`, `hospitalEditSchema, HospitalEditValues` from `@/lib/validations`. Props: `hospital: Hospital` from `@/types`. `useForm` default values from `{ hospitalName: hospital.name, hospitalAddress: hospital.address }`. Two `` fields controlled by `register('hospitalName')` and `register('hospitalAddress')` with Label, aria-invalid, and FieldError. Save button: disabled when `!isDirty || pending`, shows Spinner or `<> Save changes`. Verification status pill: if `hospital.verified` show green ` Verified`; else amber ` Pending verification`. On submit: call `updateHospitalProfile(values)`, toast error or success 'Profile saved.', reset form.

6. Create src/app/dashboard/hospital/profile/licence-upload.tsx: `"use client"`. Mirrors PhotoUpload exactly but for documents. Props: `licenseDocUrl: string | null`. Imports: `useRef, useState, useTransition`, `FileCheck, Upload` lucide icons, `toast` sonner, `uploadLicenceDoc` from `@/app/actions/hospital`, `Button` from `@/components/ui/button`, `Spinner` from `@/components/ui/spinner`. Allowed types: `['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp', 'application/pdf']`. Max size: 5 MB. Hidden `<input type='file' accept='image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp,application/pdf'>`. Show filename + size when file chosen. If `licenseDocUrl` present, show 'View current licence' link (opens in new tab) + 'Replace' button; else 'Upload licence' button. On upload: build FormData with key 'licence', call `uploadLicenceDoc(formData)`, toast success 'Licence uploaded.' or toast error. Cancel clears file state.

7. Create src/app/dashboard/hospital/profile/page.tsx: async Server Component. Fetch `hospitalApi.me(session.accessToken)` — if null render a 'No hospital profile yet' state with a note to contact support. Render: `<div className='max-w-3xl space-y-6'>`, eyebrow 'Hospital profile', h1 hospital name or 'Your hospital', email line. Then `<LicenceUpload licenseDocUrl={hospital?.licenseDocUrl ?? null} />` and `<HospitalProfileForm hospital={hospital} />`. Add metadata `{ title: 'Hospital profile' }`. Export `HospitalProfileForm` and `LicenceUpload` as named imports from their files.
8. Commit: `git add src/lib/validations.ts src/lib/hospitals.ts src/app/actions/hospital.ts src/app/dashboard/hospital/profile/` && `git commit -m 'feat: add hospital profile and licence upload'`
acceptance_criteria: hospitalEditSchema and HospitalEditValues are exported from src/lib/validations.ts
updateHospitalProfile and uploadLicenceDoc are exported from src/app/actions/hospital.ts
findings: 1. hospitalEditSchema added to validations.ts alongside HospitalEditValues (z.infer, no coerce fields so single type is sufficient). 2. hospitalApi.updateProfile and hospitalApi.uploadLicence added to src/lib/hospitals.ts; uploadLicence uses raw fetch to bypass the JSON helper, same pattern as uploadDonorPhoto. 3. updateHospitalProfile and uploadLicenceDoc added to src/app/actions/hospital.ts, reusing the existing hospitalToken() helper and ActionResult type. 4. Hospital profile page uses the same max-w-3xl space-y-6 layout as the donor profile page. 5. Verification status pill uses bg-mint/text-forest (verified) and bg-sand/text-sand-deep (pending) — both color tokens are defined in globals.css. 6. No PageProps generic used for /dashboard/hospital/profile because the page has no dynamic params or searchParams; it uses a plain async function signature. 7. npm run build and npm run lint both exit 0.
